name: Hokko Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Hokko Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries, manufactures and sells crop protection and fine chemicals products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Agricultural Chemicals Business, Fine Chemicals Business, and Textile Materials Business.
